proposals.evidence: Turner gives Hindi jījī/jijjī and Marathi jijī elder sister under the *jījja nursery family. Bhili źīźī continues this reduplicated kinship term with the survey’s palatal transcription; simple jī is excluded because a general honorific could compete.
